summary.text: Long Hair true inheritance is the refinement path true inheritance left by Long Hair Ancestor. It is kept in Lang Ya blessed land.

claims.text: Lang Ya land spirit raises three major foundations of Lang Ya Sect to Fang Yuan. First is the refinement path true inheritance left by his main body, Long Hair Ancestor, holding the essence of that life’s cultivation. The other two are Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s luck path true inheritance and Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable’s theft path true inheritance, taken as payment when the living Long Hair Ancestor refined Gu for those venerables.

He tells Fang Yuan the first suits him most. Refinement path has two styles: the hairy man heaven and earth style, and the human isolation style. Hairy men use the dao marks of heaven and earth to raise the chance of succeeding. The land spirit says his main body not only knew the essence of the hairy man heaven and earth style, he even used Old Immortal Kong Jue’s true inheritance to break past their limits, reaching a higher level, and conceptualized an immortal killer move called immortal tribulation tempering aperture.

Lang Ya land spirit offers Fang Yuan a choice among luck path true inheritance, Thieving Heaven true inheritance, or Long Hair true inheritance, as a trade for the upper extreme heavenly eagle egg. Fang Yuan refuses, calling the price low beside rank eight battle strength.

Fang Yuan and Lang Ya land spirit exchange inheritances. Fang Yuan obtains almost all of Lang Ya Sect’s inheritances, including Long Hair Ancestor’s refinement path true inheritance. That true inheritance mostly talks of the hairy man heaven and earth style refinement path method, which is not very helpful to Fang Yuan directly. Lang Ya land spirit obtains Spectral Soul’s true inheritance among the inheritances Fang Yuan pays.

Fang Yuan used Spectral Soul’s true inheritance to exchange for Long Hair true inheritance from Lang Ya land spirit. Both sides had held back, not exchanging their trump cards. Lang Ya kept Long Hair refinement path true meaning and Long Hair refinement path formation out of that exchange.

Lang Ya blessed land still holds three true inheritances: Thieving Heaven’s true inheritance, Giant Sun’s self luck true inheritance, and Long Hair’s refinement path true inheritance. Fang Yuan already has a deep understanding of them from the earlier transaction.
When Fang Yuan annexes Lang Ya blessed land, he obtains the Long Hair refinement path true inheritance and a large number of Immortal Gu.

Fang Yuan has already fully grasped Long Hair Ancestor’s refinement path true inheritance. With quasi-supreme refinement path attainment, it is easy to understand, and he places his focus on other true inheritances.

Even with quasi-supreme grandmaster attainment, he still has gains when he looks at Long Hair’s true inheritance. Conceptualization of Gu as Before had much progress because he researched that true inheritance multiple times. Long Hair’s true inheritance is on par with venerable inheritances. Fang Yuan finds it far easier to comprehend than the true inheritances of Thieving Heaven, Giant Sun, and Genesis Lotus.

positions.position: Fang Yuan obtains Long Hair Ancestor's refinement path true inheritance in an inheritance trade with Lang Ya land spirit.
positions.support: Chapter 1447. Chapter 1750 restates that Fang Yuan used Spectral Soul's true inheritance to exchange for Long Hair true inheritance.

positions.position: Lang Ya blessed land still holds Long Hair's refinement path true inheritance. When Fang Yuan annexes Lang Ya blessed land, he obtains that true inheritance.
